title: Fluid Pipes
subtitle: Copper pipes with a window
text:
Fluid pipes work like item pipes but move fluids, 250 mB every half second from each output end. They connect to tanks and machines from other mods, and to cauldrons.

The glass window shows the fluid while it moves. Filters work the same way: put a bucket of the fluid, or anything holding it, in a slot.
caption: Tank to machine

steps.text: Fluid and item pipes never join each other. Dyes keep fluid runs apart in the same way.
